role: CI gate: forbids `Int64(x.timeIntervalSince(y) * 1000)` in Emuqu/Sources (except Date() receivers, MillisecondOffset.swift, or `date-ms-ok:` lines) in favour of MillisecondOffset.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root. Python scans Emuqu/Sources and 'EmuquWatch Watch App' (MillisecondOffset.swift excluded); no files scanned -> exit 2. Per file: `//` comments blanked line by line, then the regex `Int64( <receiver>.timeIntervalSince(<arg>) * 1000|1_000` (receiver may start with `$`, so closure arguments like `$0.` match; whitespace may span lines) is run over the whole file; receivers starting `Date()` and lines containing `date-ms-ok:` exempt. Problems -> list + exit 1; else 'clean'. Wired: gates.yml (make date-ms-guard), ci.yml, Makefile. Currently red on 7 live `$0.` conversions in SleepBoundaryResolver.swift, ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift and OvernightChartsView+Stats.swift (handoffs).
